title: Shopper Approved Review
description: Schema for a customer site review in the Shopper Approved platform

reviewid.description: Unique review identifier (corresponds to the order ID)

name.description: Customer name (may be partially anonymized for privacy)

review.description: The full text of the customer review

headline.description: Short headline or title for the review

verified.description: Whether this review is from a verified purchase

helpful.description: Count of helpful votes from other shoppers

unhelpful.description: Count of unhelpful votes from other shoppers
